scope_note: Strict coverage reconciliation for pending 034. Both pending/034/001.json and 002.json were read. All 29 observations are still classification-pending in the frozen pass41 handoff. The earlier grains-nuts-028-034.json proposal covered only 19 of them; this file records the 10 previously uncovered rows and the group-level accounting. prior_proposal.revalidation_result: all 19 earlier 034 classification proposals remain compatible with the current title-first/pass41 taxonomy policy

decisions.reason: Title explicitly identifies 강냉이. Current taxonomy has an audited 강냉이 rule and classified precedent under the corn-savory-snack leaf; the broad grain shelf does not change the snack product form.
Title identifies 현미 and the retailer product detail identifies the product/origin as domestic brown rice. 돼지감자 is a product modifier; current pass41 has a dedicated brown-rice leaf.
Title explicitly describes a mixed nut/seed assortment rather than one single nut. Reuse the existing mixed-nut leaf while keeping the unresolved bundle multiplier separate from classification.
Peanut product identity is explicit. Wasabi is seasoning/flavor, not a different core product type; current pass41 has a peanut leaf.

decisions.source_title: 씻거나 불릴필요 없는 맛있는 우리 엄마 밥상 2kg
decisions.reason: The title alone is opaque, so the product detail was checked: composition includes peas, oats, brown rice, glutinous barley, glutinous brown rice and glutinous rice. This is a mixed-grain rice product, not plain white or brown rice.

held_decisions.reason: Pecan identity is explicit, but current pass41 nut leaves are almond/walnut/peanut/macadamia/cashew/pistachio/mixed; no pecan leaf was confirmed. Do not substitute walnut or mixed nuts.
Chia seed is explicit and is not one of the current pass41 nut leaves. A seed branch/candidate is safer than forcing it into mixed nuts.
Misutgaru is a processed grain powder/meal product. No current pass41 misutgaru or grain-powder leaf was confirmed; raw rice/mixed-grain leaves would lose the processed powder form.
Pumpkin seed identity is explicit, but no current pass41 pumpkin-seed/seed leaf was confirmed. Do not collapse it into mixed nuts.
Product form remains misutgaru/grain powder; protein/black-grain modifiers do not make it a ready-to-drink protein beverage. Reuse the same held grain-powder candidate as the other misutgaru row.
